findings.summary: A presigned PUT URL cannot be scoped to a maximum size, so the size claims are misleading.
findings.evidence: "Presigned URL: short expiry, scoped to one key and size" and "Enforce a max size and content type". S3 presigned PUT URLs fix the key and expiry but cannot enforce a size limit. Size limits need a presigned POST policy (content-length-range) or a server-side check.
findings.fix: Say "scoped to one key" and enforce size through a presigned POST policy or a post-upload check. Note that multipart uploads need a presigned URL per part.

findings.summary: The last bullet is misleading about the cost of each revocation approach.
findings.evidence: "Each check costs a lookup, so only the denylist stays small". The denylist and the token_version check each cost one lookup, and only the denylist's size is bounded.
findings.fix: Say: "Every approach adds a lookup per request. The denylist stays small because entries expire with the token."

findings.summary: The preflight example leaves out headers that make a preflight work.
findings.evidence: Request shows only `Origin`; response shows only `Access-Control-Allow-Methods` and `Max-Age`. The request needs `Access-Control-Request-Method: PUT`. The response needs `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, or the browser blocks it, which the text says is the rule.
findings.fix: Add `Access-Control-Request-Method: PUT` to the request and `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://a.io` to the response.

findings.summary: The S3 single-PUT size limit is stated wrongly.
findings.evidence: Table: "Single PUT | Under 5 MB". S3 allows a single PUT up to 5 GB. Multipart parts must be at least 5 MiB, except the last. AWS recommends multipart above about 100 MB.
findings.fix: Change to "Small files (under ~100 MB)" and word the bullet "parts of at least 5 MiB" instead of "5-100 MB".

findings.summary: The multipart part-upload example is incomplete.
findings.evidence: "PUT /bkt/video.mp4?partNumber=3 &X-Amz-Signature=...". S3 UploadPart also requires `uploadId` in the query.
findings.fix: Add `&uploadId=...` to the example.
